row.body: Live read 2026-11-26: tick ran, but in 24 h only operations, product and portfolio took work; 127 items parked blocked (loop-breaker, needs-code). Added ROLE-DUTIES-1 (seed/worker/src/roleduties.js, tick step role_duties): portfolio blocked share, program stale blocked, project loop-breaker rescope, product market research (one cited competitor source per hour from seed/autonomy/market.json, change files MKT-*), qa unverified closes, sre tick health, security stale secret items. ROLE-IDLE-1 names roles with no dispatch and no beat in 24 h. New roles qa-engineer, sre, security-engineer.
